info.title: MealDeck API
info.description: Multi-kitchen food delivery platform API for managing businesses, kitchens, users, customers, menus, and orders

get.description: Retrieve a list of all businesses
Retrieve a specific business by its ID
Retrieve a list of all kitchens

post.description: Add a new kitchen under a business

get.description: Retrieve a specific kitchen by its ID
Retrieve a list of all users
Retrieve a specific user by their ID

post.description: Create a new kitchen role assignment

get.description: Retrieve a specific user-kitchen role assignment

put.description: Update a user's role in a kitchen

delete.description: Soft delete a kitchen role assignment

get.description: Retrieve a list of all customers
Retrieve a specific customer by their ID

post.description: Add a new address for a customer

get.description: Retrieve a specific customer address by its ID

parameters.name: kitchen_id
parameters.description: Filter menu items by kitchen ID

post.description: Add a new menu item to a kitchen

get.description: Retrieve a specific menu item by its ID
Retrieve a specific order by its ID

put.description: Update an existing order (mainly for status updates)

parameters.name: order_id
parameters.description: Filter order items by order ID

post.description: Add a new item to an order

get.description: Retrieve a specific order item by its ID

delete.description: Remove an item from an order
